Hondo Rodeo Fest Phoenix 2026: lineup, schedule and parking

Scottsdale Sprinters’ short answer: the Hondo Rodeo Fest is at Chase Field in downtown Phoenix on Friday, November 13 (Tim McGraw, Miranda Lambert), Saturday, November 14 (Blake Shelton, Turnpike Troubadours) and Sunday, November 15, 2026 (Parker McCollum, Lynyrd Skynyrd). The Street Fest is free from noon, the rodeo runs 6 to 8 p.m. and the concerts 8:30 to 11 p.m.

Last updated: September 29, 2026

Prices start at $125 an hour for the Luxury SUV (Suburban), which seats 6, on a 4-hour minimum, so the shortest booking is $500 before 8% tax. Every vehicle is booked by the hour at its published rate and minimum, with no per-seat pricing.

When is the Hondo Rodeo Fest in Phoenix, and who is playing?

The Hondo Rodeo Fest runs Friday, November 13, Saturday, November 14 and Sunday, November 15, 2026, at Chase Field, 401 East Jefferson Street, Phoenix, AZ 85004. It is the third Hondo Rodeo Fest in Phoenix, and each night is a full rodeo competition followed by a full-length concert. The nights are Tim McGraw with Miranda Lambert on Friday, Blake Shelton with Turnpike Troubadours on Saturday, and Parker McCollum with Lynyrd Skynyrd on Sunday. The festival lists its artists as subject to change, so check its Phoenix page before the night. This page is about the Phoenix festival at Chase Field, the downtown home of the Arizona Diamondbacks.

Where do you park for the Hondo Rodeo Fest at Chase Field?

In the Chase Field Garage, attached to the ballpark just south of it on 4th Street with 1,500 spaces on a first come, first served basis, or in a space pre-booked through ParkWhiz, the Diamondbacks’ preferred parking partner. Some garages and lots around the ballpark take only credit cards and others only cash, so carry both. The festival’s own FAQ sends guests to the ballpark’s information page for parking, bags and directions, and as of September 28, 2026, neither the festival nor the Diamondbacks print a parking price for it: the price is whatever the garage or ParkWhiz shows when you buy. The alternative to a garage is light rail. The Diamondbacks list 13 Park-and-Ride locations, and trains run every 15 to 20 minutes within walking distance of Chase Field. Our Chase Field guide has every garage, the light rail stops and the full parking answer. Or skip the garage: a chauffeured group heads for a published pickup point by the ballpark, and nobody queues to pay or waits in the exit line after the last song.

Where is the drop-off for the Hondo Rodeo Fest?

The Diamondbacks publish two rideshare pickup and drop-off points at Chase Field: 5th Street north of Washington, and Jackson Street east of 9th Street. They also staff an accessible drop-off on the south side of Jefferson Street, just west of 7th Street, near Gate K. No separate limo or charter zone is published, so a chauffeured group unloads where the live traffic plan allows and agrees one pickup point for the ride home before walking in. The chauffeur drives the approach the traffic plan allows and meets the group once the crowd clears.

What is the Hondo Rodeo Fest schedule each day?

The festival’s Phoenix page splits the day into three parts. The Free Street Fest opens daily at noon and is free to attend for everyone, with no ticket required: food vendors, shopping, brand activations and live music. The rodeo runs from 6 to 8 p.m. and the concert series from 8:30 to 11 p.m. One reserved-seat ticket covers the rodeo and both concert performances of that night. The Floor Pass is an upgrade for watching the concert on the floor in front of the stage, and it needs a ticket as well. The festival prints no gate time, so the Street Fest is the way in for an early arrival. The rodeo is an invite-only, eight-event, all-star competition with no sanctioning body, as the festival describes it.

What bags are allowed at the Hondo Rodeo Fest?

The festival’s FAQ points to the Diamondbacks’ ballpark information page for bags, and that page’s clear bag policy allows one clear bag up to 12 by 6 by 12 inches or a one-gallon clear bag, plus a small clutch up to 4.5 by 6.5 inches, with no backpacks. Concerts at the ballpark can set their own entry rules, so check the festival’s page the week of the night. Settle bags at the hotel before pickup: a group that is dropped off has no car in a garage to leave anything in, and a booked vehicle waits nearby for the ride home.

Is there a floor, VIP or suite option for the Hondo Rodeo Fest?

Yes. The festival sells a Floor Pass upgrade for the concert floor, lists three VIP experiences, from the floor-level experience to club-level suite hospitality, and offers host-hotel packages. The Diamondbacks also take suite requests on the Hondo’s event page through their Suite Information form. A hosted night still needs a way in and out: the Maybach Jet or the Ultra Luxury Party Sprinter brings the guests you host from the hotel to a published pickup point and home after the encore, on one booking.

How should a group plan a Hondo Rodeo Fest night?

Start from the part of the day you care about most: the Street Fest from noon, the rodeo at 6 p.m. or the first concert at 8:30 p.m. Put the vehicle on the clock for the whole day, or book a ride out and a ride back and let the chauffeur return when your group is together. Choose the night when you book, November 13, 14 or 15: each is its own date with its own headliner. For a guest flying in, a pickup at Sky Harbor or a Valley hotel can go straight on to the festival in the same vehicle.

Which vehicle fits a group going to the Hondo Rodeo Fest?

Our pick for a Hondo night is the Ultra Luxury Party Sprinter: it seats 15 and books at $250 an hour, with a 4-hour minimum. Hosting guests on the floor or in a suite? The Maybach Jet Sprinter seats 9, and the Maybach Shuttle Sprinter and the Luxury SUV (Suburban) suit a small hosted party. A country-night crew picks from the Limo Party Sprinter (12-13 Pax) (13 seats), the Limo Party Sprinter (16 Pax) (16) and the Party Bus (28 Pax) (28), at $175 an hour, $175 an hour and $250 an hour in that order. Families and companies ride the Executive Black Sprinter, 14 reclining leather seats at $145 an hour, or the Mini Bus (24 Pax), which seats 24, when several families go together. Book on (623) 986-6339 or at reservations@scottsdalesprinters.com, giving the night, the pickup address and the rider count.

Frequently asked questions

When is the Hondo Rodeo Fest in Phoenix in 2026?

Friday, November 13, Saturday, November 14 and Sunday, November 15, 2026, at Chase Field in downtown Phoenix. Each night is a rodeo followed by a concert.

Who is playing the Hondo Rodeo Fest in Phoenix?

Tim McGraw with Miranda Lambert on Friday, November 13; Blake Shelton with Turnpike Troubadours on Saturday, November 14; and Parker McCollum with Lynyrd Skynyrd on Sunday, November 15. The festival lists artists as subject to change.

What time does the Hondo Rodeo Fest start each day?

The festival’s Phoenix page lists the free Street Fest from noon, the rodeo from 6 to 8 p.m. and the concerts from 8:30 to 11 p.m. It prints no separate gate time.

Is the Hondo Street Fest free?

Yes. The festival says the Hondo Street Fest opens daily at noon and is free to attend for everyone, with no ticket required. A ticket is for the rodeo and the concerts.

Where do you park for the Hondo Rodeo Fest?

At the attached Chase Field Garage on 4th Street, first come, first served, or in a space pre-booked through ParkWhiz. Some lots take only cards and others only cash.

Where is rideshare pickup at Chase Field for the Hondo?

5th Street north of Washington, or Jackson Street east of 9th Street. Agree on one point with your group before the night.

What bag can you bring to the Hondo Rodeo Fest?

The festival points to the ballpark’s clear bag policy: one clear bag up to 12 by 6 by 12 inches or a one-gallon clear bag, plus a small clutch up to 4.5 by 6.5 inches, and no backpacks. Check the festival’s page for its own rules.

What is a Floor Pass at the Hondo Rodeo Fest?

An upgrade that lets a ticket holder watch the concert on the floor in front of the stage. It needs a ticket, and a reserved seat covers the rodeo and both concert performances.

Can a limo or party bus drop us off at the Hondo Rodeo Fest?

Yes, where the live traffic plan allows. The Diamondbacks publish two rideshare points and a staffed drop-off on Jefferson Street but no limo or charter zone, so the chauffeur confirms the drop-off and agrees one pickup point for after the show.

Where do you buy Hondo Rodeo Fest tickets for Phoenix?

From the festival’s own Phoenix page, which sells a reserved-seat ticket that covers the rodeo and both concert performances of a night, a three-day package and Floor Pass upgrades. The Diamondbacks’ event page lists the same three nights. We sell the ride, not tickets, and print no ticket price.

What is the Hondo Rodeo Fest?

A festival in which each night is a full rodeo competition followed by a full-length concert. Phoenix is its third year, at Chase Field, and a free Street Fest opens each day at noon.

Where is the Hondo Rodeo Fest in Phoenix?

At Chase Field, 401 East Jefferson Street, Phoenix, AZ 85004, the downtown home of the Arizona Diamondbacks. The ballpark publishes two rideshare points: 5th Street north of Washington and Jackson Street east of 9th Street.
